plugins.name: Approvals
plugins.description: Every permission request and question waiting across your chats, in one list, oldest first. Allow, deny or answer each without opening its chat.

plugins.name: Bitbucket
plugins.description: Pull requests, approvals, builds and merging for Bitbucket Cloud and Data Center. Uses your bkt sign-in and keeps no token of its own.

plugins.name: Chat count
plugins.description: Shows how many chats need you, are working, are ready to review, or are done.

plugins.name: Chat panel
plugins.description: A sample that sits beside a chat: a side-panel tab naming the chat, a chat menu item, a ⌘K command, a Settings page and a Home card.

plugins.name: Dashboard
plugins.description: Shows what your chats need, what your agents used this month, and how recent turns ended.

plugins.name: Delegation
plugins.description: A chat can ask another agent to work in its own chat and branch, then receive a short report when the sub-tasks finish.

plugins.name: Follow pull request
plugins.description: Turn on Follow in a chat's Pull Request tab, and new review comments, requested changes and failed checks go to the chat's agent as one message, a couple of minutes after they arrive. It stops when the pull request is merged or closed.

plugins.name: Jira
plugins.description: Find Jira Cloud issues by key, link or words and attach them to chats. Uses Atlassian's acli sign-in on this Mac.

plugins.name: Kanban
plugins.description: Shows your chats as a board, by what they need from you.

plugins.name: Lessons
plugins.description: Save what a chat learned. Its own agent writes the lessons into the project's instructions or a skill, and the edit waits in Review for you to keep or discard.

plugins.name: Linear
plugins.description: Find Linear issues in the composer's issue search, by words, a key like ENG-123 or a link, and attach them to your messages. It uses the Linear CLI signed in on this Mac, or an optional personal API key kept in your keychain.

plugins.name: Link status
plugins.description: GitHub pull requests and issues and Linear issues linked in a chat show how they stand after the link: open, draft, merged or closed, with checks, and a Linear issue's state and assignee. They refresh every five minutes while you can see them. Private repositories need a GitHub token, and Linear needs your Linear API key, both entered here in Settings.

plugins.name: Second opinion
plugins.description: Ask another agent to review a chat's changes. It reads them without changing anything, and its findings arrive as comments in Review for you to send or delete.

plugins.name: Clay
plugins.description: A warm theme in light and dark, inspired by Claude's colours, with clay orange as its accent.
